# Proposal quality rubric

Criteria marked ▣ are enforced mechanically by `agentsdir check`; the
others belong to the critique pass (step 4).

## ▣ Mechanical

- ▣ Every created element passes `agentsdir check`: the accepted list is
  not delivered while check is red.
- ▣ Each artifact obeys the rubric of its own creator — the rule index
  line, the hook registrations in step on every harness, the sub-agent
  frontmatter. This skill delegates to them and never bypasses them.

## Critique pass

- Every element says why it is needed in THIS repo — not in repos of this
  kind.
- Every element cites its evidence, each fact marked read (with the file
  it comes from) or assumed; none rests on assumed facts alone.
- Nothing a linter, a formatter, a type checker, a CI step, an existing
  hook or a harness deny rule already enforces.
- Nothing that duplicates an existing rule, hook or sub-agent: the
  proposal completes what is installed and names what is already covered.
- No kind ranked above another: the mix follows what this repo and the
  request call for, and each element says what the other two kinds would
  not have covered.
- Few and founded: a proposal accepted without being read is a proposal
  that will be ignored.
- One verdict per line — accept, refuse or amend — and nothing written
  before every line has one.
